AeonglassBoss.defect: Orbs deal damage without playing cards (fewer Withering Presence triggers). Frost passive block tanks Ebb and Eye Lasers.
AeonglassBoss.general: 512 HP, 3 Artifact. Cycle: Ebb 22 + 33 Block → Eye Lasers 11x2 → Increasing Intensity (Wither + growing Strength). Every 6 cards you play adds a Wither to your hand. You need real scaling.
AeonglassBoss.ironclad: Stoke and Burning Pact exhaust Wither. Corruption makes Wither-clearing free. Demon Form scaling keeps up with its Strength.
AeonglassBoss.necrobinder: Souls (draw 2, Exhaust) clear Wither from hand. Osty tanks chip damage. Doom ticks regardless of Wither.
AeonglassBoss.regent: GUARDS!!! exhausts Wither. Void Form free plays offset Wither cost. Star burst on non-Ebb turns.
AeonglassBoss.silent: Calculated Gamble discards a hand of Wither (they come back on shuffle). Poison ignores its Block on Ebb turns.

CeremonialBeastBoss.defect: Multi-Cast and Hyperbeam burst past 150. Frost passive block covers Ringing turns.
CeremonialBeastBoss.general: 252 HP. Phase 1: Plow 18 dmg +2 Str every turn. Dropping it to 150 HP stuns it and wipes its Strength. Phase 2: Beast Cry (Ringing: 1 card that turn) → Stomp 15 → Crush 17 +3 Str.
CeremonialBeastBoss.ironclad: Bludgeon and Strength burst reach the 150 threshold fast. Barricade+Body Slam is perfect for Phase 2 — one card, big damage on Ringing turns.
CeremonialBeastBoss.necrobinder: Doom on the Beast works through both phases. Osty banks HP. One big Grave Warden turn crosses 150.
CeremonialBeastBoss.regent: Seven Stars is one card with massive burst for the threshold. Sovereign Blade makes each Ringing turn count.
CeremonialBeastBoss.silent: Stack Poison (Accelerant doubles ticks) to reach the threshold. On Ringing turns play your single best card.

KaiserCrabBoss.defect: Lightning orbs and Hyperbeam pressure both claws. Loop/Defragment scale all damage sources.
KaiserCrabBoss.general: Crusher (209 HP) + Rocket (199 HP). Rocket's Laser hits 31; Crusher's Bug Sting applies Weak and Frail. Surrounded: +50% damage from the claw behind you. Crab Rage: the survivor gains 6 Str + 99 Block — finish both close together.
KaiserCrabBoss.ironclad: Whirlwind hits both claws. Bludgeon finishes the second claw before Crab Rage matters. Block hardest before Laser.
KaiserCrabBoss.necrobinder: The Scythe AoE hits both. Doom on both claws lets them die close together. Rattle multi-hits.
KaiserCrabBoss.regent: Seven Stars hits both claws. Stardust damages both consistently. Black Hole AoE.
KaiserCrabBoss.silent: Poison ticks on both claws at once — ideal for balanced damage. Dagger Spray hits both.

KnowledgeDemonBoss.defect: Echo Form compensates for Sloth. Frost orbs block through Disintegration. Defragment scales through resource curses.
KnowledgeDemonBoss.general: 379 HP; heals 30 and gains Str every cycle. Cycle: Curse of Knowledge (pick Disintegration 6/7/8 dmg per turn OR Mind Rot / Sloth / Waste Away) → Slap 17 → 8x3 → Ponder. Needs real scaling.
KnowledgeDemonBoss.ironclad: Demon Form and Strength scaling outpace the heals. Corruption+Feel No Pain handles Disintegration chip damage. Fiend Fire for burst.
KnowledgeDemonBoss.necrobinder: Doom executes regardless of curses and heals. Osty tanks Disintegration damage. Souls cycle past Mind Rot.
KnowledgeDemonBoss.regent: Sovereign Blade is draw-independent — counters Mind Rot. Void Form free plays counter Waste Away.
KnowledgeDemonBoss.silent: Poison keeps ticking through every curse. Waste Away hurts least with 0-cost cards. Malaise cuts its Strength.

LagavulinMatriarchBoss.defect: Free turns for Defragment/Loop/Echo Form. Orb damage and orb block ignore the Str/Dex loss completely.
LagavulinMatriarchBoss.general: 222 HP, 12 Plating, asleep for 3 turns (or until it takes unblocked damage). Each Soul Siphon permanently removes 2 Str and 2 Dex from you. Kill before the 2nd Soul Siphon.
LagavulinMatriarchBoss.ironclad: Use the 3 free turns for Demon Form/Inflame/Offering. Favour big single hits (Bludgeon) and big single blocks (Impervious) — Soul Siphon hurts multi-hits most.
LagavulinMatriarchBoss.necrobinder: Doom ignores the Str/Dex loss. Osty blocks regardless of your Dex. Use the free turns for Capture Spirit/Dirge.
LagavulinMatriarchBoss.regent: Free turns are perfect for Forge setup (Sword Sage, Seeking Edge). Sovereign Blade forge damage ignores the Strength loss.
LagavulinMatriarchBoss.silent: Free turns for Noxious Fumes and Footwork setup. Poison ignores the Strength loss. Big Dex-based blocks lose value after each Siphon.

QueenBoss.defect: Frost orbs give block that ignores Frail. Creative AI makes powers. Defragment scales Focus. Echo Form for value.
QueenBoss.general: Queen (400 HP) + Torch Head Amalgam (199 HP). T1: 3 Chains of Binding (first 3 cards drawn are Bound). T2: 99 Frail/Weak/Vulnerable. Kill the Amalgam, then the Queen enrages: 3x5 → 15 → +2 Str.
QueenBoss.ironclad: Offering and Battle Trance draw past Bound cards. Feel No Pain + Dark Embrace block ignores Frail. Barricade keeps block across turns.
QueenBoss.necrobinder: Souls (draw 2, Exhaust) cycle past Bound cards. Osty blocks regardless of Frail. Doom on the Queen ignores her Block.
QueenBoss.regent: Void Form free plays offset Bound cards. Sovereign Blade forge outscales the fight. Star generators work through Chains.
QueenBoss.silent: Adrenaline/Tools of the Trade keep drawing past Bound cards. Poison damage ignores your Weak. Afterimage blocks ignore Frail.

SoulFyshBoss.defect: Coolheaded draws past Beckons while channeling Frost. Scrape cycles through them. Hologram fetches key cards back.
SoulFyshBoss.general: 211 HP. Cycle: Beckon (2 Beckons) → De-Gas 16 → Gaze 7 + Beckon → Fade (Intangible) → Scream 13 + 3 Vulnerable. Clear Beckons and don't waste burst on Fade turns.
SoulFyshBoss.ironclad: True Grit/Burning Pact exhaust Beckons. Fiend Fire dumps a cluttered hand. Feel No Pain turns each exhausted Beckon into block.
SoulFyshBoss.necrobinder: Souls (draw 2, Exhaust) cycle past Beckons. Osty soaks chip damage. Haunt deals damage through Fade.
SoulFyshBoss.regent: Void Form free plays offset energy spent on Beckons. Glow draws past them. Convergence holds key cards.
SoulFyshBoss.silent: Discard engine (Prepared, Calculated Gamble, Acrobatics) clears Beckons. Afterimage gives block per card played. Hold attacks on Fade turns.

TestSubjectBoss.defect: Orb damage needs no Skills in Phase 1. Frost block holds Phase 2 claws. Echo Form doubles value in Phase 3.
TestSubjectBoss.general: Phase 1 (100 HP): Enrage — gains Str whenever you play a Skill; Bite 20 / Skull Bash 14 + Vuln. Phase 2 (200 HP): Multi-Claw 10x3, +1 hit every turn. Phase 3 (300 HP): Lacerate 10x3 → Big Pounce 45 → Burning Growl (Burns + Str).
TestSubjectBoss.ironclad: Attack-heavy turns in Phase 1 (avoid Skills). Kill Phase 2 fast before Multi-Claw stacks. Impervious for Big Pounce. Strength scaling carries all three phases.
TestSubjectBoss.necrobinder: Doom executes in every phase. Osty tanks Phase 2 claws and Big Pounce. Souls cycle past Burns.
TestSubjectBoss.regent: Sovereign Blade forge scaling carries through all three phases. Seven Stars burst to end Phase 2 quickly.
TestSubjectBoss.silent: Shivs are Attacks, so they are safe in Phase 1; Poison Skills feed Enrage. Wraith Form blunts Multi-Claw. Block every Big Pounce.

TheInsatiableBoss.defect: TURBO/Double Energy fuel the Escape costs. Echo Form doubles value per turn.
TheInsatiableBoss.general: 321 HP. Opens with 4 Sandpit and 6 Frantic Escapes. Play Frantic Escapes to push back Sandpit, or you die. Cycle: Thrash 8x2 → Lunging Bite 28 → Salivate +2 Str → Thrash. Draw and energy are survival.
TheInsatiableBoss.ironclad: Corruption makes Frantic Escapes free (they are Skills). Offering/Bloodletting give the energy. Demon Form scales between Escapes.
TheInsatiableBoss.necrobinder: Borrowed Time gives energy for Escapes. Graveblast retrieves key cards. Osty tanks Lunging Bite while you cycle.
TheInsatiableBoss.regent: Void Form makes Escapes free. Convergence retains hand to guarantee an Escape. Alignment generates Stars for burst windows.
TheInsatiableBoss.silent: Adrenaline/Tactician provide the energy. Calculated Gamble cycles to find Escapes.

TheKinBoss.defect: Hyperbeam clears all three at once. Frost orb block ignores Frail. Focus the Priest with single-target orbs.
TheKinBoss.general: Priest (190 HP) + 2 Followers (58-59 HP). All three gain Strength; Priest applies Weak and Frail. The fight ends when the Priest dies — Followers flee.
TheKinBoss.ironclad: Whirlwind/Conflagration AoE pressures all three while you focus the Priest. Feel No Pain block ignores Frail. Flame Barrier punishes their many small hits.
TheKinBoss.necrobinder: The Scythe AoE hits all three. Doom on the Priest — once it dies the Followers flee. Rattle multi-hits.
TheKinBoss.regent: Seven Stars and Astral Pulse hit all three. Gamma Blast AoE wave. Sovereign Blade singles out the Priest.
TheKinBoss.silent: Dagger Spray and Haze hit all three. Poison and No Escape ignore Weak. Focus the Priest — no Follower cleanup needed.

VantomBoss.defect: Lightning orbs strip 1 Slippery per hit. Claw spam strips Slippery fast. Scrape cycles through Wounds.
VantomBoss.general: 173 HP with 9 Slippery (each hit deals 1 and removes a stack). Cycle: Ink Blot 7 → Inky Lance 6x2 → Dismember 27 + 3 Wounds → Prepare +2 Str. Kill before the 3rd Dismember.
VantomBoss.ironclad: Whirlwind/Conflagration multi-hits strip Slippery. Inferno ticks remove a stack every turn. Stoke and Burning Pact clear the Wounds Dismember adds.
VantomBoss.necrobinder: Doom ignores Slippery entirely — execute when Doom >= HP. Osty soaks Dismember. Souls (draw 2, Exhaust) cycle past Wounds.
VantomBoss.regent: Seven Stars strips 7 Slippery stacks in one play. Lunar Blast multi-hits. Forge scaling on Sovereign Blade outpaces Vantom's +2 Str/cycle.
VantomBoss.silent: Shivs strip Slippery 1 stack per Shiv. Even small Poison removes a stack per turn (Accelerant: more). Weak from Neutralize/Leg Sweep softens Dismember. Prepared discards Wounds.

WaterfallGiantBoss.defect: Frost orbs give passive block that carries through the explosion. Glacier channels 2 Frost. Hyperbeam burst.
WaterfallGiantBoss.general: 240 HP. Heals 15 with Siphon; Pressure Gun grows +5 each use. Stores Steam Eruption all fight — after the kill it turns invulnerable and Explodes for the stored amount next turn. Keep a big block for that turn.
WaterfallGiantBoss.ironclad: Demon Form scales through the long fight. Impervious covers the explosion. Second Wind blocks through it.
WaterfallGiantBoss.necrobinder: A Doom kill with no Steam Eruption stored skips the explosion. Osty absorbs the blast. Dirge heals you back.
WaterfallGiantBoss.regent: Save a big block via Bulwark/Bodyguard. Sovereign Blade forge scales through the fight. Void Form free plays save energy for block.
WaterfallGiantBoss.silent: Poison keeps ticking for steady damage through the heals. Backflip and Leg Sweep for the explosion turn.
